lines: Indeed. I really can feel his presence...
I (the boar) muttered while pressing my snout to the ground to sniff around.
Kiyomaro, the lucky boar, who had turned me into his "scapegoat," had apparently taken human form and was hiding.
Once that happened, it was difficult to find him because he could not be identified by his hulking body.
However, since I was summoned to this dimension alongside him, I shared a part of his soul and could detect his presence.
And that was why Asagi-san had told me, "If anyone, you should be able to sniff him out."
Yeah. Judging by the scent, he came down the mountain and is heading toward the village...
Well, the best place to hide a tree is in a forest.
If he had disguised himself as a human, it would be convenient to hide in the village, where there were lots of people.
...That's a bit of a pain. We could lose sight of him if he blends in among the townspeople.
Yeah... And in a place with so many people, his presence should be weaker...
We need to hurry. But, do your best not to stand outーPfft!
Asagi-san looked at me and burst out laughing.
Asagi-san!? Wh-What the heck, suddenly looking at someone's face and...!?
It just felt a bit silly to be talking to a boar with a totally straight face... Pfft!
Hey now!! Take this a bit more seriously!! It's a critical moment that will determine if I'm a boar for life or not!!!
Hehe, I know. Don't worry, I'm serious too♪
Asagi-san's giggle switch was stuck in the "on" position.
While I thought "Sheesh," I asked Asagi-san about something that had been weighing on my mind.
By the way, Asagi-san, how did you know I was the "scapegoat"?
The group of Taimanin from the encounter earlier had attacked me (the boar) without listening to reason.
But Asagi-san seemed to presume that I was the "scapegoat."
Oh, that... I was with the old lady from a shop called Inageya when I first learned about you.
She must have been talking about that shop that also existed in my dimension, a popular hangout for the students of Gosha.
That old lady and I know each other from a minor incident last year... We were just about to do hatsumode together, partly as thanks for that.
I see, so that's why you're wearing such a fancy kimono.

There had been so much going on that I hadn't noticed, but Asagi-san was dressed in an elegant kimono for hatsumode, the traditional first shrine visit of the year, even though we were in the middle of the mountains.
Oh, this? It doesn't suit me?
N-No, it looks pretty good, I think.
In fact, it looked ridiculously good and cute on her, but I was embarrassed, so I left it at that.
Hehe, thank you♪ It's a hand-me-down from my grandmother who wore it when she was young.
S-So what if it is!? It looks good on me... It does look good on me, doesn't it?
Ahh!? Y-Yes, of course!! Sorry for saying something weird...!
That was close. I'd be in big trouble if I offended her and she wouldn't help me with the boar hunt.
A-Anyway... The old lady at Inageya gave me some advice. She told me it was possible there was a "scapegoat."
That's right. Apparently this ceremony was also performed once when the old lady from Inageya was still young.
And a scapegoat was used then tooー
But the other factions don't have intel about a scapegoat yet.

Not only the Taimanin, but also demons and the UFSー
they're all after the power from the luck.
Since they don't know you're a scapegoat, they'll come and try to kill you like they mean it.
I had gotten dragged into something much worse than I had thought.
But, wait!! If you tell them, wouldn't that just, bam, take care of it?
You're the leader of all Taimanin. I'm sure they'd listen to you...
I'm the leader of all Taimanin? I can only give orders to the Igawa Clan. I keep my distance from the Taimanin of Gosha.
(She was the headmistress of Gosha Academy in my dimension... but not here, I guess?)
When I tilted my head in confusion, Asagi-san asked with a suspicious look on her face.
Just who are you? You seem to know about the affairs of Taimanin...?
I stuttered, unsure where to start, whenー
We turned around, and sure enough, there was a young girl in a kimono.
Happy New Year, miss. Sorry, but can you hand over Mr. Boar there? Consider it a New Year's gift for Felly♪
Without replying to the girl, Asagi-san muttered with a stern look.
I told you, remember? There are several factions after your power, including demons and the UFS.
B-But...!! I'm just a fake!! They won't get any power by killing me, right!?
Yeah. You were just a victim of circumstance...
As Asagi-san and I were bickering under our breath, the girl puffed out her cheeks like she was annoyed.
Hmmph... You're ignoring Felly. Then Felly will be the one to start playing with you.
The young girl snapped her fingers.
Simultaneously, a group of armed demons appeared behind her.
The power from the luck belongs to Lady Felicia!
Running away... doesn't seem like an option. I'll handle the girl! You take care of the small fries!
If it came to this, then we had no choice.
We readied ourselves as the group of demons charged at us.
